verdict.rationale: Runpod maintains a public pricing page (runpod.io/pricing) with billing described as per-second/per-hour compute costs and no sales contact required, and docs describe per-second billing for Pods/Serverless plus discounted commit terms, implying transparent self-serve pricing. However no evidence pack item shows an actual per-GPU-hour price table enumerating every GPU type's rate, so the specific breadth of coverage (every GPU type at a stated hourly rate) is unconfirmed. missing for 10: an actual screenshot/listing of per-GPU-hour rates for each GPU type, independent confirmation that the pricing page lists all GPU SKUs without requiring a quote.
